idea-plugin.name: SLeeLa IDE Integration
idea-plugin.description:
SLeeLa IDE Integration

First-class SLeeLa language support for the IntelliJ Platform, with mixed-language project integration for C, C++, and Java.

SLeeLa is a Java-like native systems language that compiles to bytecode on a Turing-complete C/C++ execution core. This plugin keeps the native SLeeLa compiler (Sleelvac™) authoritative: syntax, parsing, and diagnostics come from the real compiler, never a second grammar.

  • Recognizes .sleela source files.
  • Syntax highlighting derived from the normative SLEELA.syntax grammar.
  • Live diagnostics from the native sleela check compiler bridge.
  • Line/block comment support and a customizable color scheme.
